n0.hypothesis: Train one shared NCA on three real psychedelic loops at native 512x512 with visible motion and perturbation recovery, using staged pilots within 5 USD
n0.insight:
[from n1] Native 512 targets need not imply full-canvas BPTT: spatially aligned patch states preserve native pixels and fit in under 2GiB, while a streaming full-canvas evaluator verifies actual 512 output.
[from n2] Native resolution is computationally feasible, but raster-video temporal representation is now the bottleneck. Reject sharp static approximations even when PSNR improves.
[from n4] Four-cycle diagnostic separates two failures: weak motion already in cycle1, and accumulating RGB bias worsens appearance with age. Training horizon alone will not restore motion. Test direct visible readout before adding capacity.
[from n5] Aesthetic acceptance is part of the objective. Stop optimizing rejected source footage; use a small shader-family preview to establish the next dataset before bulk rendering or paid training.
